name: Clown Crew Cappello
pendEffect: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 non-Pendulum "Clown Crew" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also until the end of the next turn after this effect resolves, you cannot activate the effect of monsters Special Summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Clown Crew Cappello" once per turn.
